terms.fifo: First-In, First-Out (FIFO) assumes the shares bought first are sold first when calculating realized gains and average cost.
terms.fifoTip: If purchase prices vary over time, FIFO affects realized gains on partial sales.
terms.dca: Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA) invests a fixed amount at regular intervals regardless of price fluctuations.
terms.dcaTip: Helps lower your average cost during market downturns without timing the market.
terms.lumpSum: Lump Sum investing puts your entire investment capital to work at a single point in time.
terms.lumpSumTip: Historically in bull markets, immediate exposure often outperforms DCA due to earlier market participation.
terms.sharpe: The Sharpe Ratio measures excess return per unit of volatility (risk). Higher values indicate better risk-adjusted returns.
terms.sharpeTip: Above 1.0 is generally good; above 2.0 is considered very strong.
terms.volatility: Volatility (annualized standard deviation) measures how widely asset returns fluctuate around their average.
terms.volatilityTip: Lower volatility means smoother performance and smaller drawdown swings.
terms.unrealizedPnL: Unrealized PnL is the profit or loss on current holdings based on current market price versus cost basis, not yet realized by selling.
terms.dailyPnL: Daily PnL is the dollar and percentage change in portfolio value compared to the previous trading day's close.
terms.weight: Weight is the percentage of total portfolio market value held in this asset.
terms.avgCost: Average cost basis per share across currently held lots (excluding fees).
terms.marketValue: Current market value is shares held multiplied by the latest market price.
terms.initialCapital: Initial capital available at the start of the simulation.
terms.dcaAmount: Fixed amount invested periodically at each interval.
terms.symbolSpy: SPY is the benchmark ETF tracking the S&P 500 index.
